candidate_relations.label: Severe Asthma with acute exacerbation
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents life-threatening features: SpO2 83%, pH 7.137, PCO2 74.7 mmHg (type II respiratory failure with respiratory acidosis), prior ICU admission requiring >10 days mechanical ventilation, and current hemodynamic/respiratory compromise meeting near-fatal asthma criteria. C001 correctly identifies severe asthma with acute exacerbation but does not specify the near-fatal severity tier, the hypercapnic respiratory failure, or the respiratory acidosis—all required components of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures severe asthma with acute exacerbation but omits the near-fatal qualifier, type II respiratory failure (hypercapnic: PCO2 74.7 mmHg, pH 7.137), and respiratory acidosis

case_quality_flags: Near-fatal asthma designation supported by prior prolonged mechanical ventilation, current severe hypercapnia (PCO2 74.7), acidemia (pH 7.137), and critical hypoxemia (SpO2 83%)
Eosinophilia (7.2%) consistent with atopic/eosinophilic asthma phenotype but not required for primary diagnosis
Oxygenation index 232 mmHg on FiO2 41% indicates moderate hypoxemic component alongside dominant hypercapnic failure
